title: 跟 Shuo 学中文 · A Day with Shuo
subtitle: Video companion · Hanzi recognition · self-paced speaking

source.author: ShuoshuoChinese说说中文
source.sourceNote: The supplied YouTube URL could not be read as a transcript in this session. All practice sentences below are newly authored, NOT quotations, captions, or a reconstruction of the creator's story. Do not label them as words spoken in the video.

scenes.title: Morning · 早上
scenes.cue: Imagine waking up and deciding what to do first.
scenes.hanzi: 我早上先起床，然后喝水。
scenes.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang xiān qǐchuáng, ránhòu hē shuǐ.
scenes.english: In the morning I get up first, then drink water.

scenes.title: Breakfast · 早饭
scenes.cue: Describe your breakfast and what you drink.
scenes.hanzi: 我吃早饭的时候，喜欢喝热茶。
scenes.pinyin: Wǒ chī zǎofàn de shíhou, xǐhuan hē rè chá.
scenes.english: When I eat breakfast, I like drinking hot tea.

scenes.title: Going out · 出去
scenes.pinyin: Chī wán zǎofàn, wǒ chūqù zǒuzou.
scenes.english: After finishing breakfast, I go out for a walk.

scenes.title: Shopping nearby · 附近
scenes.cue: Think of a small purchase in your neighborhood.
scenes.hanzi: 我去附近的商店买一点儿东西。
scenes.pinyin: Wǒ qù fùjìn de shāngdiàn mǎi yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
scenes.english: I go to a nearby shop to buy a few things.

scenes.title: Back home · 回家
scenes.cue: Describe what you do once you get home.
scenes.hanzi: 回家以后，我先工作，然后练习中文。
scenes.pinyin: Huí jiā yǐhòu, wǒ xiān gōngzuò, ránhòu liànxí Zhōngwén.
scenes.english: After I get home, I work first, then practise Chinese.

scenes.title: Evening · 晚上
scenes.cue: Finish your story with what you do before bed.
scenes.hanzi: 晚上我休息一下，然后睡觉。
scenes.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ xiūxi yíxià, ránhòu shuìjiào.
scenes.english: In the evening I rest a little, then go to sleep.
